results.title: Dog food recalled across US and Canada after complaints of metal contamination
results.description: Nearly 5,800 cases of Fromm Turkey Pâté and Diner Classics Milo’s Meatloaf Pâté are being recalled over potential metal contamination. No illnesses or injuries have been reported.
